scope: A pick for every Hotspawn CS2 match: independent two-layer replay of the published 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z board (featured snapshot.json + complete origination list, 10 active fixtures), live check of the official Valve inputs, HLTV-first live research for the four fixtures not resolved as featured market picks, and verification that the executive summary carries a separated unresolved section with limitations and a one-tap phone path to every pick.
method: scripts/3e64f4fb_verify.py re-derived every active row in both layers from the inputs each row publishes (Polymarket bid/ask midpoints, Thunderpick proportional no-vig, Valve Glicko from published points), checked every pick is the strict favourite, checked the featured-blank fixture's researched resolution carries quote evidence and an evidence-backed alias, and resolved every in-site link from the executive summary. The official Valve standings file was fetched live over api.github.com and all six published model/cross-check inputs were matched. Live Hotspawn/HLTV/esportsbook reads run on a GitHub runner (scripts/3e64f4fb_probe.py) because the sandbox has no egress to those hosts; observed prices are recorded raw and no probability is originated there.

items.area: Every active match has a pick (verified on the 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z build)
items.finding: All 10 active Hotspawn CS2 fixtures carry a directional pick on the published board: 7 from an external betting line (6 Polymarket market midpoints in the featured layer, 1 Thunderpick no-vig pair), 1 researched Polymarket line in the complete list (1082792, where the featured layer stays blank), and 2 labelled Valve research-model estimates (1082861, 1082793). The independent two-layer replay found 0 errors: every probability recomputes from its own published quotes/odds/rating points, every pick is the strict favourite of its pair, counts recompute (inventory 72, upcoming 10, archived 62), no row attributes a probability to Hotspawn, and no crowd field appears in any estimate.
items.handling: Published as verified. The replay is fixture-agnostic (a blank row graduating to a sourced pick passes), so it cannot repeat the 2026-10-25 publisher-freeze class where a closing coverage gap failed the gate.

evidence.detail: Executive summary of the verified build: 10 picks ready of 10, 0 unresolved, every fixture card shows both win probabilities and the pick.
Example featured market source: 1082858 published 20.0%/80.0% from bid/ask 0.18-0.22 and 0.78-0.82; replayed exactly.
Bookmaker endpoint for 1082859: stored pair 1.61/2.18 replays to the published 57.5%/42.5% after proportional margin removal.

items.area: Featured-unresolved fixture 1082792 HOTU vs The Huns: refusal correct, researched resolution evidenced
items.finding: The featured layer leaves 1082792 blank because Valve publishes two different rosters named The Huns. Verified live against Valve's official standings_global_2026_10_05.md (blob 2aa2805, still the newest file on 2026-10-26): The Huns appears at #122 with 944 points and again at #213 with 701 points, so the identity refusal is correct. The complete list resolves the fixture as HOTU 87.0% / The Huns 13.0% from a Polymarket book (bid/ask 0.82-0.92 and 0.08-0.18) joined via the competition-scoped alias 'The Huns Esports', which carries three https evidence links (HLTV match 2399437, the Polymarket market page, the Hotspawn fixture page) plus an HLTV 4-of-5 roster disambiguation to standing #122. The 0.10 spread is within the 0.12 policy cap but is the widest quoted spread on the board, so the midpoint is correspondingly less precise than the 0.01-0.04 spreads of the other market rows.
items.handling: Published as verified with the spread limitation stated here and in the verification dossier. No value was changed: the featured blank, the researched resolution and the model cross-check (94.1%/5.9% from HOTU 1437 vs The Huns 944, replayed exactly) are all shown with their own sources.

evidence.detail: Official Valve table fetched live: The Huns at #122 (944 pts) and #213 (701 pts); all six published model/cross-check inputs matched standing, points and roster exactly.
HLTV match page used for the alias evidence and the 4-of-5 roster disambiguation to Valve standing #122.
Researched market line behind the complete-list pick: observed 82-92c / 8-18c at 2026-10-25T23:04:05Z.

items.area: Near-untraded market under a near-coin-flip pick (1082900 Luminosity vs HOTU)
items.finding: 1082900 is published at 52.5%/47.5% (pick Luminosity) from a Polymarket book with total traded volume of $7.25 at observation time. The midpoint arithmetic replays exactly, but a book that has traded seven dollars cannot carry the same evidential weight as the $9,822 book behind 1082901, and the row's limitation does not mention volume. A 52.5% favourite from a near-untraded market is materially weaker information than the summary card's bare 'Pick Luminosity 52.5%' suggests.
items.handling: Changed nothing: the published number is what the book showed and its source is linked. Flagged for the owner of scripts/collect.py to consider a minimum-volume label (or threshold) so a near-untraded book is shown as thin the way a wide spread already can be. Does not block the merge.

evidence.detail: The market behind the row: stored snapshot records volume 7.25 and liquidity 14796.52 at 2026-10-25T23:03:43Z, quotes 0.51/0.54 and 0.46/0.49.

items.area: Model pick inside rating noise (1082861 Rooster vs Abyssal, 16 rating points)
items.finding: 1082861 has no betting line and is priced by the Valve research model: Rooster 718 points (#205) vs Abyssal 734 (#195), a 16-point gap that produces 47.8%/52.2% and a pick of Abyssal. The arithmetic replays exactly from Valve's official file, but a 16-point gap at rank ~200 - from a standings file dated 2026-10-05 (verified still Valve's newest on 2026-10-26) in an explicitly uncalibrated model - is inside any reasonable noise band. The methodology limitations are published, yet the phone summary card presents 'Pick Abyssal 52.2%' with the same visual weight as a sourced market line.
items.handling: Changed nothing: the model row is labelled as a research estimate, sits in the separated 'picks without a betting line' register, and its limitations are linked. Flagged for the build/origination owners to consider a near-coin-flip marker (for example under 55%) on summary cards so phone readers can tell a coin-flip model lean from a priced favourite at a glance. Does not block the merge.

evidence.detail: Official inputs verified live: Rooster #205 718 pts, Abyssal #195 734 pts, rosters exactly as published.

items.area: Nine evidence downloads absent from the checked-in root (branch-root parity gap)
items.finding: The executive summary links nine current-snapshot Polymarket evidence files (event/book JSON for events 1231333, 1237427, 1237429) that do not exist in the checked-in repository root under data/evidence/. The workflow-artifact deployment serves them - polymarket-event-1231333.json was read successfully from the live site on 2026-10-26 - but GitHub Pages is configured in legacy mode with source main:/, so a branch-root serve would return 404 for exactly the saved-evidence links a reader taps to audit the three affected picks. No navigation link is affected: every page and anchor link from the summary resolves.
items.handling: Changed nothing in the publisher (out of this session's scope). Flagged for the owner of scripts/root_publish.py: either sync the evidence downloads the rendered pages link, or stop the rendered summary from linking files the root sync drops. Logged as a request in COORDINATION.md; does not block the merge because the live artifact deployment serves the files today.
